audit_items.proof_trace: The exchange_rate formula uses the explicitly tracked `self.cash` field, not `underlying_balance.value()`, so direct token transfers to the underlying balance cannot inflate the exchange rate. Every path that increases `self.cash` either (a) issues proportional ctokens via `mint_ctokens`, or (b) simultaneously increases `self.cash_reserve` by the same amount (excess repayment at L209-210, `increase_reserve_only`, flash loan fees), leaving `cash - cash_reserve` unchanged. No external path can add to `underlying_balance` without going through module-controlled accounting, making the classic donation-inflation attack impossible.
